summary: The diff modifies frontend/src/index.css to set the body background-color to oklch(0.83 0.04 65), which corresponds to approximately #DCCBB5 (royal beige). The change is applied via the body selector in index.css globally. Text colors, glow effects, neon styles, fonts, button styles, borders, layout, shadows, animations, and card styles appear unchanged. The --dark-bg and --dark-surface CSS custom properties remain as dark OKLCH values and are not replaced with beige, but the body background itself resolves to royal beige as required.

missing_requirements.requirement: Replace all black background color values including dark OKLCH background variables with royal beige #DCCBB5
missing_requirements.reason: The :root CSS custom properties --background (0.08 0.01 240), --dark-bg (oklch(0.06 0.01 240)), --dark-surface (oklch(0.1 0.015 240)), --dark-surface-2 (oklch(0.14 0.02 240)), --card (0.1 0.015 240), --popover (0.12 0.015 240), --sidebar (0.1 0.015 240), and scrollbar track (oklch(0.08 0.01 240)) remain as dark OKLCH values. The requirement states to replace all dark OKLCH background variables. The body selector is correctly set to beige satisfying the primary AC, but the :root --background variable is still dark which could be interpreted as a global root background value that was not replaced.
